source.title: Impeachment Trial of Vice President Sara Duterte

turns.speaker: Alfredo Sotto Corpuz
turns.text: Senate President, the Presiding Officer, and Senator-Judges of the Impeachment Court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The Sergeant at Arms is directed to make the proclamation.

turns.speaker: Alfredo Sotto Corpuz
turns.text: All persons are commanded to keep silent under the pain of penalty while the Impeachment Court is in session for the trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte is hereby called to order. We shall be led in prayer by Senator-Judge Robin Hood Padilla.

turns.speaker: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla
turns.text: Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim. Alhamdulillahi Rabbil 'alamin. Panginoon naming nag-iisa, ang nag-iisang hukom, Panginoon ng lahat ng mga daigdig, ang pinakamaawain, ang pinakamahabagin. Panginoon namin, hinihingi po namin ang inyong talino sa oras na ito. Sa oras na ito na ibinigay po sa amin ang pinakamabigat na obligasyon upang makapagbigay ng hustisya. Batid po namin Panginoong Allah na kayo lamang po ang nag-iisang hukom at ang pagiging hukom ay napakabigat na nakalagay po sa aming balikat upang magbigay ng hustisya, hindi lamang po sa mundong ito. kundi ito po ay isang bagay na dadalhin ng aming bayan sa kanyang kasaysayan. Napakabigat po nito, Panginoong Allah, at kayo lamang po ang makapagbibigay sa amin ng lakas ng loob upang magbigay ng tamang justisya sa oras na ito. Amen.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Amen. The Clerk of Court will now call the roll.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Roll call up members, Senator-Judge Aquino, Senator-Judge Cayetano Alan, Senator-Judge Cayetano Pia, Senator-Judge De La Rosa, Senator-Judge Ejercito, Senator-Judge Estrada, Senator-Judge Goh, Senator-Judge Ontiveros, Senator-Judge Lacson, Senator-Judge Lapid, Senator-Judge Legarda, Senator-Judge Marcoleta, Senator-Judge Marcos, senator-judge Padilla, senator-judge Pangilinan, senator-judge Sotto III, senator-judge Tulfo Erwin, senator-judge Tulfo Rafi, senator-judge Villanueva, senator-judge Villar Camil, senator-judge Villar Marc, senator-judge Zubiri, the presiding officer, senator-judge Escudero, Senate President Gatchalian.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: With 19 senator-judges present, the chair declares the presence of a quorum. In accordance with the rules of procedure on impeachment trials, the Chair now recognizes the duly elected Presiding Officer to preside over the proceedings of the Impeachment Court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Senate President. If there are no objections, we shall dispense with the reading of the August 3, 2026 Journal of the Senate, sitting as an Impeachment Court, and shall consider the same as approved.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Bago po tawagin ang presiding officer ang kaso na kabinbin sa impeachment court, may nais lamang po akong sabihin sa ngalan nating lahat.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Magkakaiba man ang ating pananaw at baga man magkakatunggali ang magkabilang panig dito sa impeachment court, may mga bagay-bagay na dapat pinagkakasunduan at pinagkakaisahan natin, lalo na dun sa mga napuya't kagabi kakapanood ng TV. At para sa akin ang isa po dito. Ayan, tagumpay at kampyonato ng ating magaling at magiting na kababayan na si Alex Ayala sa DC Open.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Kaya't sa ngalan ng Senado ng mga senator-judges, mga kawanin ng Senado, sa ngalan ng magatong galing mga partido ng impeachment trial, nais po naming ipabatid. Ang aming nagkakaisang pagbati kay Binibining Alex Ayala sa kanyang panalo at kampyonato sa DC Open, tunay na ikinararangal at ipinagbubunyikan naming lahat. Congratulations sa'yo, Alex.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Kaya pag may inaantok po na senator-judge,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: malamang nanood kagabi.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: The clerk of court is instructed to kindly call the case before this impeachment court.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Case number 004-2026 in the matter of impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Appearances.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Your Honor, same appearance for the prosecution. I understand, Your Honor, that this is a con... Continuation of the direct examination of the prosecution's witness, Atty. Wamil. And with that, Your Honor, may we ask that the counsel for the prosecution, Atty. Lorna Capunan, be recognized.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Noted. At the proper time, yes. Counsel for respondent appearances.

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Same appearance for the respondent accused. Good morning, Your Honors.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Good morning. Before the presiding officer calls on the counsel for the panel of prosecutors, attorney Capunan, for the continuation of his cross and the witness, the chair would like to ask if the respondent, or rather counsel for respondent, has been furnished with a copy of the motion of the panel of prosecutors with respect to the request for judicial notice.

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Yes, sir. Yes, that is correct, Your Honors. We were furnished yesterday.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: For your information, counsel, we will hear. Your arguments for or against it and or a written opposition or agreement with that motion tomorrow. Just to give you advance information before we start the trial. So do you have enough time?

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Okay. Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: At this juncture, Chair, I would now like to recognize with the permission of the Honorable Chua, the prosecutor, rather the counsel for the panel of prosecutors, Attorney Capunan, and Chair instructs the Clerk of Court to bring the witness, Mr. Wamil, before the witness stand.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Mr. Wamil, it is understood that you will be continuing with your testimony under the same oath that you had and did yesterday. Do you understand that, sir?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Atty. Kapunan, counsel for the panel of prosecutors, you may continue with your direct examination of the witness, Mr. Wamil, of the Commission on Audit.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honors.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: To the Senate Impeachment Judges and to the Presiding Officer and Senate President, I beg the indulgence of this honorable court to start this with a recess.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: The reason this is necessary, Your Honor, is because yesterday, when prosecution asked for a recess with the permission or consent of the counsel for the respondent, we started to identify and cross-check the 845 acknowledgement receipts. Unfortunately, time ran out and our assisting counsels only were able to show half. Although this court will recall that under Rule 130, Section 3, in coordination with Section 7, we were able to mark a tabulation or a summary prepared personally by this witness, Your Honor, to preempt any possible objection of the respondents and any manifestation that they were not allowed. to compare the copies of our exhibits and their own exhibits as regards the rest of the acknowledgement receipts, Your Honor, unless they will stipulate that there is no need, Your Honor, then it becomes necessary for a brief recess, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Counsel, for what purpose is the recess?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Your Honor, please, yesterday, when we resumed hearing yesterday, Your Honor, and we were going over these three boxes and... several folders, Your Honor. It had to abruptly stop because we had resumed session. And at that time, our associates noted that kalahati lang po ang natapos sa pag-compare.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Counsel, the presiding officer will have a query first beforehand. Yesterday, you presented a summary and a table of his findings based on the 845 acknowledgement receipts contained in the six

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: or three boxes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: And you presented some samples.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: I count one, two, three, four, five, six, six samples, examples rather. So you mean to say you want to present more acknowledgement receipts as samples as part of the tabulation of the witness?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: No, Your Honor. What we would like to do now and inquire from counsel for the respondent is if it's no longer necessary for your associates to look over the said acknowledgement receipts, Your Honor, if they can manifest that and to preempt any possible technical objection in the future. on their cross-examination or upon offer of this exhibit, Your Honor, because these exhibits will have to be offered in due time. And we do not want it as an objection to the offer that they were not able to compare the rest of the acknowledgement receipts, Your Honor. Now, to preempt that, if counsel is willing to forego with that potential objection, Your Honor, we are ready to proceed.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: You're talking of only the acknowledgement receipts for the period covering December 21 to December 31, 2022. Yes, Your Honor. Is that what you're referring to? I think I know what counsel-respondent will already say but yes, counsel-respondent, what is your comment on the manifestation of the counsel for the panel of prosecutors?

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Your Honor, we haven't stipulated on anything so I don't see why there's a need to compare actually. We haven't stipulated on anything.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Actually, Attorney Capunan, counsel for the respondent already said yesterday that I'm just subject to cross insofar as the non-stipulated matters is concerned.

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: That's correct.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: The counsel for respondent stipulated on everything you asked for in your list of documents except for that. Except for the acknowledgement receipts for the period covering December 21 to 31, 2022. My understanding, counsel, is that you will be presenting samples from the tabulation or summary of the witness. And as I said, you presented already six. You may proceed to present samples or examples under each category of this table. Without prejudice, however, many they may be subject to your call and discretion given the refusal to stipulate. by the counsel-respondent, which is, of course, they would be well within their rights not to do so, given their own legal theory of the case.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: We submit, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: So kindly proceed, counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: With the permission of this honorable court, same appearance, good morning to the senator-judges. Mr. Witness, yesterday, you were able to identify 845 going through these documents, acknowledgement receipts. Mr. Witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Yes ma'am. In

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: this 845 acknowledgement receipts which the prosecution marked as exhibits P-1-8-1 up to P-1-8-848, there is a portion there and I will show you a sample on the screen. There is a portion in all of these acknowledgement receipts at

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: the bottom thereof. There is a signature in

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: the phrase certified true copy.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Can we present this witness with a sample acknowledgement receipt?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Assistant counsel may approach from both parties. It's still attorney Peña, right?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: I remember.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: His mother will be happy again.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Can you go through some of this acknowledgement receipt, Your Honor?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: While counsel is going over... Showing over these acknowledgement receipts to our witness, Mr. Juan Mil,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: we would like to make a manifestation that at the bottom portion of all of these exhibits identified or being identified now by this witness, have the statement certified

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: true copy being shown on the screen.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Mr. Witness, can you read?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: It's a certified crew copy and there is a name, Davin Bacay. Would you know who this person is?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Who is Mr. Bacay?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Siya po'y admin staff ng Kowa Ikfaw.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Kowa Ikfaw. And his signature, there is a signature that appears over the name Davin Bacay. Whose signature is this?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Sa kanya po. Why do you know?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Davin Bacay po. Nakita ko po siyang pumirma ng ibang dokumento at yung kanyang pirma sa mga dokumentong iyon ay kapares po ng kanyang pirma sa certified true copies.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: In all of these acknowledgement receipts that you have seen or saw yesterday,

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: is it the same bakay that certified as to these photocopies being certified true copies?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Yes, ma'am. Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Your Honor, with that, we will proceed where we left off yesterday, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Yes, I believe you were able to identify already the checks and made the witness identify the checks already for the first, second, and third quarter, counsel, if I'm not mistaken.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed, counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Yesterday, Mr. Witness, we had identified and you had confirmed certain land-bound checks. We will now go to disbursement checks, which you said... Disbursement vouchers, which you said were among the documents submitted by the Office of the Vice President to liquidate, to allegedly liquidate her confidential funds, if shown to you, Mr. Witness. Three disbursement vouchers. And again, with the kind permission of the court and for easy reference of the honorable impeachment judges on screen. And if you please check this copy. Being shown to you, these are stipulated documents, Your Honor, and common exhibits of both the prosecution and the defense. For the prosecution, there is a disbursement voucher dated January 31, 2023, Exhibit P-1-10-B. Shown on the screen.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Likewise, there is a disbursement voucher dated April 10, 2023, Prosecutions Exhibit P-1-10-C and likewise, the Defense Exhibit. And lastly, disbursement voucher dated July 13, 2023, Prosecutions Exhibit P-1-10-D.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Mr. Witness, sinabi

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: With the indulgence of counsel, just for the record, the same pieces of evidence identified by the counsel for the panel of prosecutors are also marked, respectively, as D-133-OVP, D-1-57, rather, 30, no, no, 33-OVP, D-1-57-OVP, and D-1-82-OVP for the respondent. Counsel may proceed.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. Now, Mr. Witness, sinabi mo kahapon na itong mga disbursement vouchers ay sinabmit ng Vice President mismo ng office niya.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Okay. Pakisabi sa atin, ano ba ang significance nito mga disbursement vouchers na nakikita natin sa screen?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ang significance po ng disbursement voucher na ito, ito po kasi yung mag-initiate nung kanilang pag-process nung cash advance. Dito rin po ang nag-certify yung various signatories nung disbursement voucher.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Ang disbursement voucher, sinabi mo, dito nag-uumpisa ang proseso?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Anong proseso yan?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Nang kanilang pag-withdraw po ng kanilang cash advance for the confidential fund.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Withdrawal ng cash advance, para saan periods? There are three disbursement vouchers shown on the screen and which you have identified. For clarity. Ano ang mga periods na kino-cover nitong disbursement vouchers na to?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Based on these disbursement vouchers po, ang period covered ay yung first DV, first quarter of 2023, yung second DV, second quarter of 2023, at yung third DV po ay third quarter of 2023.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: So covered ang tatlong quarters ng confidential funds.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Based on these documents po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Based on these documents. We go now to another set.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Oh, there is a signature here.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Here in the middle, there appears a signature being flashed

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: on the screen. Nakalagay certified expense, cash advanced, necessary, lawful, and incurred under my direct supervision. You confirm, Mr. Witness?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Whose signature is this, if you know?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: This is the signature po of the Vice President, Sara Duterte.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And why do you know that this is her signature?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Because the Office of the Vice President submitted po the specimen signatures of the signatories of their documents and included in that submission po is the specimen signature of the Vice President and her signature po on that specimen signature is the same po with her signature on this document.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Nakikita natin yung tatlong signature ng Vice President sa disbursement vouchers na yan. What is the significance of her signature in these three disbursement vouchers kung masasabi mo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Based on these documents po, sinertify ni Vice President na yung kanyang cash advances ay kailangan na ayon sa batas at na-include po under her direct supervision.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And ano ang observations mo? dito sa tatlong disbursement vouchers na to.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: With respect lang po dun sa disbursement voucher for the third quarter of 2023, hindi po napirmahan yung box E, which is the receipt of payment portion.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Anong significance ng observation mo na to?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Ito po kasi yung patunay na na-receive ni kung sino man po yung pay nung cheque, yung payment.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: At sa pagka-evaluate mo nitong disbursement vouchers na to, ito ba ay compliant sa joint circular na sinabi mo kahapon?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Based on my evaluation po, wala naman po akong nakitang findings bukod dun sa walang signature yung box E of the third quarter disbursement voucher.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Punta naman tayo sa next set of documents. Tatlo na naman to for the three periods that you mentioned. Showing to you on the screen and please go over the documents being presented by Attorney Pena. There is a liquidation report dated March 29, 2023. Prosecutions Exhibit P-1-9B.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: A liquidation report dated July 11, 2023, which is Prosecutions Exhibit P-1-9C and a liquidation report dated October 23, 2023, Prosecutions Exhibit P-1-9D. A common exhibit. stipulated by counsel for the respondent yesterday, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Again, with the indulgence of counsel for the panel of prosecutors, for the record and for the easy reference of senator-judges, the three documents referred to by attorney Capunan respectively are marked as well by the respondent as D-1-30-OVP, D-1-55-OVP. D-1-80-OVP. Do you confirm, counsel?

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: I confirm, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Counsel, for the panel of prosecutors, attorney-component, you may proceed.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. In the middle of these three liquidation reports, there appears to be an indication, quote-unquote, certified purpose of cash advance duly accomplished. Do you confirm that, Mr. Witness?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And there is a signature, again, appearing on top.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: There is a signature appearing thereat. Whose signature is this?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: This is the signature of the Vice President, Sara Duterte.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And you're familiar with this for the same reason, Mr. Witness?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Now,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: what is the significance of the statement, Certified Purpose of Cash Advance, duly accomplished? With the signature of the Vice President appearing in all of these certifications.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Based on these documents po, ang significance po noon ay sinertify po ni Vice President na yung purpose nung kanilang CASHA DAT advances ay na-accomplish po nung agency.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And any observations as regards these three documents?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Wala naman po akong nakitang findings about these liquidation reports po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Just for purposes of clarity, itong three documents are similar to the three periods, the first quarter, the second quarter, and the third quarter months that you earlier mentioned, Mr. Witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Can you repeat the question, ma'am?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Itong tatlong, this verse, itong tatlong dokumento na nakikita mo dyan, para saang period ito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Based on these liquidation reports, yung first liquidation report, ang period covered ay February 6 to March 29, 2023. Yung second liquidation report ay April 25 to June 30, 2023. At yung third liquidation report ay July 14 to September 30, 2023.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Okay. Para maalala natin, to remind us, Mr. Witness, for these three quarters,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: of the office of the Vice President for which she submitted liquidation reports. Magkano ang amount ng confidential fund per quarter?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Based on these documents po, ang amount ng kanilang quarter Likasya Advance ay 125 million pesos per quarter.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Ito ba ay fixed amount?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Based on these documents po, yes ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: At ito ba ay winidron ng buo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Roderick C. Wamil
turns.text: Based on these documents po, yes po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
